basic_info.description: Welcome to 1125 Mendell St, located in the vibrant and up-and-coming North Bayview neighborhood. This bright and spacious home offers three bedrooms, two bathrooms, and multiple living spaces, including an extra-large living area with a skylight. This home  features a large kitchen with stainless appliances and granite countertops. The home feels bigger than it looks, offering plenty of room to live and grow. A rear flex room with its own entrance adds versatility—perfect to be the primary bedroom, guest quarters or a home office. Enjoy easy access to the San Francisco lifestyle with nearby 3rd Street light rail, shopping, dining, and major city hubs. This home truly combines space, comfort, and convenience.
